facts.raw_span: painless right testicular swelling of several weeks’ duration
without systemic symptoms
glaucoma, prostatic adenomectomy, and hernioplasty
dorzolamide, lansoprazole, and dutasteride
enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis with ipsilateral hydrocele
swelling persisted
bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement measuring 15×12 mm on the right and 27×18 mm on the left
these nodules were absent on a CT scan 3 years earlier
intense uptake (SUVmax 25.5) in the right testis
no uptake in the adrenal glands
normal electrolytes, blood count, iron studies, protein electrophoresis, glucose, renal and liver function, thyroid profile, LDH, and β2-microglobulin
negative for active HCV and EBV (positive for past EBV)

concepts.why: The patient has painless testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT, which is consistent with testicular lymphoma.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal adenoma.
The patient has testicular swelling and epididymal enlargement, which is consistent with epididymitis.
The patient has painless testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT, which is consistent with testicular cancer.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal hyperplasia.
The patient has testicular swelling and epididymal enlargement, which is consistent with orchiepididymitis.
The patient has painless testicular swelling with intense uptake on PET/CT, which is consistent with testicular seminoma.
The patient has bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement, which is consistent with adrenal incidentaloma.
It explains the absence of uptake in the adrenal glands on the 18 FDG PET/CT scan.

rationales.F01: Painless testicular swelling is more typical of testicular lymphoma or seminoma than epididymitis.
rationales.F05: Enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis with ipsilateral hydrocele is highly suggestive of testicular lymphoma or seminoma.
rationales.F07: Bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement is more typical of adrenal hyperplasia or incidentaloma.
rationales.F09: Intense uptake in the right testis is highly suggestive of testicular lymphoma or seminoma.
